capabilities: attach start/pause/resume stopwatches to any text line
persist timing data across file closes and app restarts
start and update timers automatically from task status changes
adjust recorded time with a scroll-wheel time picker
scope timer behavior to folders via whitelist or blacklist
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and includes a detailed version log and issue credits; no screenshots or troubleshooting section.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to measure how much time is spent on a specific task or text block within a note.

relations.evidence: For Task Plugin Users, you can trigger the start and update of timers by simply clicking the checkbox

summary: Per-line stopwatch plugin that attaches count-up timers to text lines to track time spent on tasks.
